mapper.select: /* selectBuyerMdAmUserInfoList */ SELECT A.USER_ID, A.USER_NAME_LOC, A.USER_NAME_ENG, A.LANG, A.EMAIL, A.USER_TYPE, A.ZIP_CODE, A.COUNTRY, A.CITY, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE = A.COUNTRY) COUNTRY_NAME, NVL( (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M004' AND CODE = A.CITY), (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE = A.CITY) ) AS CITY_NAME, A.MOBILE_PHONE, A.ADDRESS_LOC, A.ADDRESS_ENG, A.PHONE_NUMBER, A.FAX_NUMBER, A.COM_CODE, B.COM_NAME_LOC, B.IRS_NO, B.CORP_CODE, (SELECT CORP_NAME FROM BNTBUYERGROUP A WHERE A.CORP_CODE = B.CORP_CODE) AS CORP_NAME, A.PURCHASE_DEPT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C001' AND CODE = A.PURCHASE_DEPT AND COMPANY_CODE = A.COM_CODE) AS PURCHASE_DEPT_TEXT, NVL(A.SMS_RECV_FLAG,'N') AS SMS_RECV_FLAG, NVL(A.MAIL_RECV_FLAG,'N') AS MAIL_RECV_FLAG, A.DEPARTMENT, A.POSITION, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C001' AND CODE = A.DEPARTMENT AND COMPANY_CODE = A.COM_CODE) AS DEPARTMENT_TEXT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C003' AND CODE = A.POSITION AND COMPANY_CODE = A.COM_CODE) AS POSITION_TEXT, A.CHANGE_USER_TYPE, A.DELY_TO_LOCATION, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE='C012' AND COMPANY_CODE = A.COM_CODE AND CODE = A.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AS DELY_TEXT, A.ROLE, DECODE(SUBSTR(A.ROLE,2,1),'+','주문 : ','')||DECODE(SUBSTR(A.ROLE,0,1),'G','입고','P','발주','C','발주 : 입고','U','조회') AS ROLE_NAME, A.USER_GROUP, A.ROW_CNT, A.IMG_VIEW_FLAG, A.PERSON_AUTHOR, A.ZIP_KEY, NVL(A.ADDRESS_LOC1, A.ADDRESS_LOC) AS ADDRESS_LOC1, A.ADDRESS_LOC2, A.STATUS, (SELECT COUNT(DOCU_TYPE) FROM ICOGPASS WHERE COMPANY = #{st_com_code}) AS ICOGPASS, A.LEGACY_USER_ID, A.MAIL_RECV_CHOICE, A.TWO_FACTOR_YN, A.CHG_INFO_PWD_YN FROM ICOMLUSR A, ICOMCMPY B WHERE 1=1 AND A.COM_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND UPPER(A.USER_ID) = UPPER(#{st_user_id}) AND A.COM_CODE = #{st_com_code}

/* selectBuyerMdAmUserInfoApproved */ SELECT A.APPR_ID, A.APPR_NAME, A.APPR_SEQ, A.GUBUN FROM ICOMAPSE A, ICOMAPPT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND A.APP_PATH = B.APP_PATH AND A.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND A.GUBUN = 'C' AND NVL(B.DEFAULT_FLAG,' ') = 'Y' ORDER BY A.APPR_SEQ

/* selectBuyerMdAmUserInfoRefer */ SELECT A.APPR_ID, A.APPR_NAME, A.APPR_SEQ, A.GUBUN FROM ICOMAPSE A, ICOMAPPT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND A.APP_PATH = B.APP_PATH AND A.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND A.GUBUN = 'R' AND NVL(B.DEFAULT_FLAG,' ') = 'Y' ORDER BY A.APPR_SEQ

/* selectBuyerMdAmUserInfoAgree */ SELECT A.APPR_ID, A.APPR_NAME, A.APPR_SEQ, A.GUBUN FROM ICOMAPSE A, ICOMAPPT B WHERE 1=1 AND A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND A.APP_PATH = B.APP_PATH AND A.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND A.GUBUN = 'H' AND NVL(B.DEFAULT_FLAG,' ') = 'Y' ORDER BY A.APPR_SEQ
